_comment: Local smoke test of the shard job on cleaned parts without dedup: copy to out/smoke.json, fill in the <...>, and run run_pipeline.py with it. Overlap and dedup are no-op folders from noop_dedup.py (nothing removed). F2, survivor loss, the ledger, the shards and reconcile run for real. Until gates 5 and 11 land on g1-pipeline: the shards use p1536 with any_tokenizer (shards marked 'test'), the pack table is shards/pack_table.json (no licence field yet), and packs lists only code-* packs that are in <cleaned> (the other packs have lane null there). ledger.raw needs the raw parts the clean job read and its reports/ folder; drop the ledger entry if you do not have them (the ledger then starts at the cleaned documents).

ledger.raw: <raw sample folder the clean job read>
